brand_notes: Bronze 7G range is Monitor Audio's current entry series (2025): 50 7G standmount 6" C-CAM + 1" gold dome, 3 kHz crossover, rear HiVe II port, split crossover (bi-wire). $849 pair US; UK GBP 500. Hi-Fi News measured 4.18 ohm min and 2.05 ohm EPDR vs 8 ohm rating. Silver 50 7G has Erin spinorama data (separate packet).
takeaways: Only Tier-B data: Hi-Fi News lab report, 87.2 dB @1k / 86.7 dB mean, min Z 4.18 Ω @ 200 Hz, EPDR 2.05 Ω @ 125 Hz
Response ±1.9 dB 200 Hz-20 kHz, flatter with 15 deg toe-in; remove grille; bass extension 49 Hz (basis unstated)
No Klippel/spinorama data found; directivity and LW deviation not recorded
What Hi-Fi? 5 stars (5/5/5), HFN 88% sound; slightly assertive character
conflicts: Claimed 8 Ω vs measured 4.18 Ω min, EPDR 2.05 Ω
